title: Smart Data Models - AGROVOC - Concept
description: An idea or notion; a unit of thought (skos:Concept). In AGROVOC, one of about 42,100 concepts covering agriculture, food, nutrition, fisheries, forestry, environment and related domains, labelled in up to 42 languages and linked by SKOS hierarchical/associative relations, mappings to other vocabularies, and the Agrontology's specific relations (e.g. hasPest, isProducedBy, hasTaxonomicRank). Attributes are the properties actually used on AGROVOC concepts in release 2026-11-05 (counted on the AGROVOC SPARQL endpoint), named exactly as in SKOS, SKOS-XL, DCMI and the Agrontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Concept:<AGROVOC local id> (e.g. c_8373, xl_en_1299522993458, agrovoc).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Concept'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:created is 'created').

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:modified is 'modified').

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

sameAs.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs'. Not an AGROVOC statement (Smart Data Models addition): the canonical AGROVOC IRI of this resource (http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrovoc/<local id>), which the NGSI-LD entity id is derived from.
